title: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治~Rail corrugation grinding
focus: 波磨波長接觸激振與材料去除量~Corrugation wavelength contact excitation and material removal
summary: 鋼軌波磨研磨整治以「波磨波長接觸激振與材料去除量」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋼軌波磨把空間不平順轉成輪軌週期激振，研磨要同時保留輪廓、材料餘量與缺陷判讀，表面變亮不是品質證明。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。~This course develops corrugation wavelength contact excitation and material removal through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Rail corrugation converts spatial irregularity into periodic wheel contact excitation; grinding must preserve profile, material reserve and defect interpretation, and a shiny surface is not proof of quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
history: 本課把鋼軌波磨研磨整治放在可追溯的技術演進脈絡中，不把機構研究、規範出版與個別路線通車混為一談。鋼軌波磨把空間不平順轉成輪軌週期激振，研磨要同時保留輪廓、材料餘量與缺陷判讀，表面變亮不是品質證明。下列年代欄是工程事件、相關研究或規範出版節點；除明確標明實際工程事件者外，並非本專題設備的製造或投入營運日期。工程改進的判準是能否以量測區分假說，不能只依新舊設備外觀判斷。~The course places Rail corrugation grinding in a traceable engineering context and distinguishes institutional research, standards publication and the opening of individual lines. Rail corrugation converts spatial irregularity into periodic wheel contact excitation; grinding must preserve profile, material reserve and defect interpretation, and a shiny surface is not proof of quality. The timeline identifies engineering events, relevant research and standards-publication milestones. Unless explicitly labelled as a project event, a date is not the manufacture or commissioning date of the equipment. Improvement is assessed by whether measurements distinguish hypotheses, rather than by the apparent age of machinery.
example: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz；y=v/fs*1000=10 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=11 mm。模型邊界：時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。~This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=20 m/s, fs=2000 Hz; y=v/fs*1000=10 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 mm. Boundary: Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.

units.anchor: 波磨通過頻率~Corrugation passage frequency
units.title: 波磨通過頻率~Corrugation passage frequency
units.mechanism: 空間波長經速度轉換為時間激振頻率。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 550 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振。使用同步速度及波長頻譜作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Speed converts spatial wavelength into temporal forcing frequency. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 550 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded. Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m；y=v/lam=500 Hz。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=550 Hz。模型邊界：單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=30 m/s, lam=0.06 m; y=v/lam=500 Hz. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=550 Hz. Boundary: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以同步速度及波長頻譜區分模型與觀察，先用合成輪廓波長譜、同步速度及振動頻譜建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「波磨通過頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic profile-wavelength spectrum, synchronous speed and vibration spectrum, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Corrugation passage frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長。這個失效與「波磨通過頻率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查同步速度及波長頻譜，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. This failure and a measurement bias in Corrugation passage frequency can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength.
units.practice: 重算「波磨通過頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出單一空間波長及定速度；不另含車輪偏心或其他激振如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由車速改變會移動振動頻峰而非改變波長造成偏離的合成觀察，以同步速度及波長頻譜說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Corrugation passage frequency, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: One spatial wavelength at constant speed; wheel eccentricity and other excitation are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Speed change moves the frequency peak without changing wavelength. Explain which evidence in synchronous speed and wavelength spectrum distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.anchor: 空間取樣間隔~Spatial sampling interval
units.title: 空間取樣間隔~Spatial sampling interval
units.mechanism: 固定取樣頻率下車速越高，沿軌點距越大。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。時間取樣均勻且速度固定；未計遺失取樣及編碼器滑移。使用編碼器位置與取樣時刻作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空間取樣過疏會混疊短波磨，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At fixed sampling rate, faster travel increases spatial point spacing. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform temporal sampling and constant speed; missing samples and encoder slip are excluded. Use encoder position and acquisition time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Coarse spatial sampling aliases short corrugation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.

units.anchor: 正弦輪廓斜率~Sinusoidal profile slope
units.title: 正弦輪廓斜率~Sinusoidal profile slope
units.mechanism: 同振幅下波長越短，輪廓最大斜率越大。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.00575959 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。小振幅單一正弦輪廓；結果為最大斜率的大小。使用輪廓高度與導數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只報振幅會忽略短波的陡峭性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~At equal amplitude a shorter wavelength gives a larger maximum slope. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.00575959 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A small-amplitude single sinusoidal profile; the result is maximum slope magnitude. Use profile height and its derivative as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Amplitude alone hides the steepness of short waves; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.00005 m, lam=0.06 m；y=2*pi*A/lam=0.00523599 1。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=0.00575959 1。模型邊界：小振幅單一正弦輪廓；結果為最大斜率的大小；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.00005 m, lam=0.06 m; y=2*pi*A/lam=0.00523599 1. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.00575959 1. Boundary: A small-amplitude single sinusoidal profile; the result is maximum slope magnitude; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以輪廓高度與導數區分模型與觀察，先用校準輪廓儀、空間振幅波長及數值導數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「正弦輪廓斜率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use profile height and its derivative to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibrated profilometer, spatial amplitude and wavelength, and numerical derivative, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Sinusoidal profile slope. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

units.anchor: 幾何激振加速度~Geometric excitation acceleration
units.title: 幾何激振加速度~Geometric excitation acceleration
units.mechanism: 理想追隨正弦輪廓的加速度與頻率平方相關。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 542.828 m/s2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。質點完全追隨正弦幾何；不代表含接觸濾波的實際車輪加速度。使用幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；剛性追隨假設可能高估實際輪軌加速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~Ideal sinusoidal profile-following acceleration scales with frequency squared. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 542.828 m/s2. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A particle perfectly follows sinusoidal geometry; actual wheel acceleration with contact filtering is not represented. Use geometric profile and contact-filter model as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Rigid following can overestimate actual wheel acceleration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz；y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=542.828 m/s2。模型邊界：質點完全追隨正弦幾何；不代表含接觸濾波的實際車輪加速度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.00005 m, f=500 Hz; y=(2*pi*f)**2*A=493.48 m/s2. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=542.828 m/s2. Boundary: A particle perfectly follows sinusoidal geometry; actual wheel acceleration with contact filtering is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以幾何輪廓與接觸濾波模型區分模型與觀察，先用原始正弦輪廓、理想導數與輪軌濾波後合成訊號建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「幾何激振加速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use geometric profile and contact-filter model to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using raw sinusoidal profile, ideal derivatives and synthetic contact-filtered signal, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Geometric excitation acceleration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

This failure and a measurement bias in Geometric excitation acceleration can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check geometric profile and contact-filter model rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. Boundary: Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以波磨振幅與通過噸位區分模型與觀察，先用配準波磨振幅、累積通過總噸位及車種紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「波磨再生速率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use corrugation amplitude and gross tonnage to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using registered corrugation amplitudes, cumulative gross tonnage and rolling-stock records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Corrugation regrowth rate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效。這個失效與「波磨再生速率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查波磨振幅與通過噸位，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Corrugation regrowth rate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check corrugation amplitude and gross tonnage rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation.
units.practice: 重算「波磨再生速率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出在指定噸位區間使用平均增幅；不保證線性長期成長如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由季節與車種改變會使線性成長外推失效造成偏離的合成觀察，以波磨振幅與通過噸位說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Corrugation regrowth rate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mean growth applies over the specified gross-tonnage interval; long-term linear growth is not assumed. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Season and rolling-stock changes invalidate linear extrapolation. Explain which evidence in corrugation amplitude and gross tonnage distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

units.title: 輪廓均方根值~Profile RMS
units.mechanism: 均方根描述高度能量尺度但不保留相位與位置。本模型把 a1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 15.0997 um。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位。使用原始輪廓與位置索引作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。~RMS describes a height-energy scale but discards phase and position. In this model, a1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 15.0997 um. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained. Use raw profiles and position index as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
units.model: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：a1=20 um, a2=-10 um, a3=10 um；y=sqrt((a1**2+a2**2+a3**2)/3)=14.1421 um。只把 a1 增加百分之十，y=15.0997 um。模型邊界：三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。~Original assumed example, not field operating values: a1=20 um, a2=-10 um, a3=10 um; y=sqrt((a1**2+a2**2+a3**2)/3)=14.1421 um. Increasing only a1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=15.0997 um. Boundary: Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.
units.verify: 本單元以原始輪廓與位置索引區分模型與觀察，先用原始點高程、里程索引及去趨勢規則建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「輪廓均方根值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。~Use raw profiles and position index to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using raw point elevations, chainage index and detrending rules, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Profile RMS. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.
units.failure: 相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷。這個失效與「輪廓均方根值」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始輪廓與位置索引，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。~Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. This failure and a measurement bias in Profile RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check raw profiles and position index rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.
units.misconception: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷~This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects.
units.practice: 重算「輪廓均方根值」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出三點等權且已去除不相關基準偏移；不保留空間相位如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同均方根可對應不同局部缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以原始輪廓與位置索引說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。~Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Profile RMS, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Three equally weighted points with unrelated datum offset removed; spatial phase is not retained. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal RMS can correspond to different local defects. Explain which evidence in raw profiles and position index distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
